description:
aeonujo is a AEON wallet manager for Android.
It is a lightwallet: it uses remote nodes for synchronizing to the Aeon
blockchain while keeping all your private data on your device. You can run
your own node at home or connect to nodes provided by the Aeon community
- it's up to you!
Monerujo is open-sourced and released
under the Apache License 2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).
AEON is a digital currency with a small footprint and a practical focus
on private transactions.
